sources.note: Wordlist-only data, no prose. All 192 East Damar forms carry a primary-stress mark (ˈ) from Taber's IPA transcription, e.g. ˈlero 'sun', ˈvulnɔ 'moon', liˈanti 'sky', ˈmatar 'sand', lalˈno 'road', larˈwo 'sail', ˈmata+no 'eye', ˈlima+no 'hand'.
